name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Emergency Power Capacitor EPC-5
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Emergency Power Capacitor EPC-5
description: A compact supercapacitor that stores a massive electrical charge and can discharge it in a single burst or as sustained power over several hours. The EPC-5 is the size of a canteen and stores enough energy to power a cyberdeck for 48 hours, jump-start a vehicle, or deliver a single 50kW pulse for weapons applications. The capacitor charges from any power source in 15 minutes and can be recharged thousands of times without degradation. Its dual-mode capability — sustained low-power or instantaneous high-power discharge — makes it the most versatile portable power source in GLMZ.

specifications.info: 000+ charge cycles; vehicle interface; weapon power port; short-circuit protected

story_hooks: An EPC-5 was used to power an improvised electromagnetic pulse device — the 50 kW burst mode provided enough energy to disable every electronic device within 20 meters.

A chain of EPC-5 capacitors has been wired in series to create a power supply capable of running a plasma cutter for an hour — the setup was used to breach a vault door in a district with no power grid access.
